div: Meet the person who grows your food

History.p_history: 'I am Juan De Dios Herrera, and I have been cultivating this beautiful land of Barichara for 18 years, inherited from my grandfather. Since childhood, I learned the secrets of traditional Santander agriculture. My farm, La Esperanza, has witnessed generations of honest and dedicated work. I grow more than 15 different varieties, from ancestral grains to fresh vegetables that go directly to the restaurants of this magical town. Every seed I sow carries love for this land and the commitment to feed the families of Barichara with fresh, high-quality products. My greatest satisfaction is knowing that my crops are part of the traditional dishes that delight visitors from all over the world.'
